sights.w: Apple's original headquarters (1993-2017, still active offices/labs) on the private U-shaped street Infinite Loop, the iconic '1 Infinite Loop' address. VIEWABLE ONLY now: the public Apple Company Store that once operated here (exclusive Apple-branded merch you could buy nowhere else) PERMANENTLY CLOSED on Jan 20, 2024, so there is no longer anything open to the public inside. Photograph the entrance sign and campus from the perimeter (De Anza Blvd / Mariani Ave / N Tantau); for a public Apple stop, use the Apple Park Visitor Center instead.

sights.address: 100 Bay View Dr, Mountain View, CA 94043
sights.w: Google's first self-built campus (opened 2022), an architectural landmark famed for its tent-like BIG + Heatherwick 'dragonscale' roof of ~50,000 prismatic solar shingles, on NASA Ames land beside Moffett. The interior is not open to the public, but the campus is edged by public bike/walk trails (Bay Trail / Stevens Creek corridor) from which the roofline is visible. A viewing, not an entry.
